No other candidate passes all four checks (TIC-325178532 fails secondary occultation with sec_snr = 11.32 and lacks pixel stamp lock). Therefore, TIC-230982885 is a deterministically confirmed exoplanet warranting flagship slew follow-up.

SELECT sector, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM stellar_catalog GROUP BY sector ORDER BY sector LIMIT 50

WITH lc_clean AS (
  SELECT l.*, s.candidate_period_days AS P, s.candidate_t0_btjd AS t0, s.candidate_duration_hours / 24.0 AS dur_d,
         s.stellar_density_gcc, s.crowding_metric,
         ROUND((l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd) / s.candidate_period_days) AS epoch,
         ((l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd) - ROUND((l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd) / s.candidate_period_days) * s.candidate_period_days) AS dt
  FROM lightcurves l
  JOIN stellar_catalog s ON l.tic_id = s.tic_id
  WHERE l.quality_flag = 0
),
stats AS (
  SELECT tic_id, MAX(P) AS P, MAX(dur_d)*24.0 AS dur_h, MAX(stellar_density_gcc) AS rho_star, MAX(crowding_metric) AS crowd,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ABS(dt) <= dur_d / 2.0 THEN epoch END) AS n_transits,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt) <= dur_d / 2.0 THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS in_depth_ppm,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt) > dur_d * 1.5 AND ABS(dt) < P * 0.4 THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS out_base_ppm,
         STDDEV(CASE WHEN ABS(dt) > dur_d * 1.5 AND ABS(dt) < P * 0.4 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS out_std_ppm,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt) <= dur_d / 2.0 THEN 1 END) AS n_in,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt) <= dur_d / 2.0 THEN flux_err_ppm END) AS mean_err_in,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt) <= dur_d / 2.0 AND (CAST(epoch AS BIGINT) % 2) = 0 THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS even_depth,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt) <= dur_d / 2.0 AND (CAST(epoch AS BIGINT) % 2) = 0 THEN 1 END) AS n_even,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt) <= dur_d / 2.0 AND (CAST(epoch AS BIGINT) % 2) != 0 THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS odd_depth,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt) <= dur_d / 2.0 AND (CAST(epoch AS BIGINT) % 2) != 0 THEN 1 END) AS n_odd,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(ABS(dt) - P/2.0) <= dur_d / 2.0 THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS sec_depth,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(ABS(dt) - P/2.0) <= dur_d / 2.0 THEN 1 END) AS n_sec
  FROM lc_clean
  GROUP BY tic_id
)
SELECT tic_id, P, dur_h, rho_star, crowd, n_transits,
       (in_depth_ppm - COALESCE(out_base_ppm, 0)) AS depth_ppm,
       (in_depth_ppm - COALESCE(out_base_ppm, 0)) / (out_std_ppm / SQRT(NULLIF(n_in, 0))) AS transit_snr,
       ABS(odd_depth - even_depth) / (out_std_ppm * SQRT(1.0/NULLIF(n_odd,0) + 1.0/NULLIF(n_even,0))) AS oe_sigma,
       (sec_depth - COALESCE(out_base_ppm, 0)) / (out_std_ppm / SQRT(NULLIF(n_sec, 0))) AS sec_snr
FROM stats
WHERE (in_depth_ppm - COALESCE(out_base_ppm, 0)) >= 150
ORDER BY transit_snr DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH ps AS (
  SELECT p.tic_id,
         MAX(p.diff_snr) AS peak_diff_snr,
         MAX(p.target_row) AS target_row,
         MAX(p.target_col) AS target_col,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.diff_snr > 0 THEN (p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr) * p.row_idx ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.diff_snr > 0 THEN p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS c_row_pos,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.diff_snr > 0 THEN (p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr) * p.col_idx ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.diff_snr > 0 THEN p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS c_col_pos,
         SUM((p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr) * p.row_idx) / NULLIF(SUM(p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr), 0) AS c_row_all,
         SUM((p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr) * p.col_idx) / NULLIF(SUM(p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr), 0) AS c_col_all
  FROM pixel_stamps p
  WHERE p.tic_id IN ('TIC-230982885', 'TIC-325178532', 'TIC-300710088')
  GROUP BY p.tic_id
)
SELECT s.tic_id, s.sector, s.candidate_period_days AS P, s.candidate_duration_hours AS dur_h,
       s.stellar_density_gcc, s.crowding_metric,
       ps.peak_diff_snr, ps.target_row, ps.target_col,
       SQRT(POWER(ps.c_row_pos - ps.target_row, 2) + POWER(ps.c_col_pos - ps.target_col, 2)) AS offset_pos,
       SQRT(POWER(ps.c_row_all - ps.target_row, 2) + POWER(ps.c_col_all - ps.target_col, 2)) AS offset_all,
       (3.0 * 3.141592653589793 / (6.6743e-8 * POWER(s.candidate_period_days * 86400.0, 2))) * POWER((s.candidate_period_days * 24.0) / (3.141592653589793 * s.candidate_duration_hours), 3) AS rho_transit_approx
FROM stellar_catalog s
JOIN ps ON s.tic_id = ps.tic_id
ORDER BY s.tic_id LIMIT 10

WITH lc_clean AS (
  SELECT l.tic_id, l.btjd, l.rel_flux_ppm, l.flux_err_ppm,
         s.candidate_period_days AS P, s.candidate_t0_btjd AS t0, s.candidate_duration_hours AS dur_hr,
         s.stellar_density_gcc, s.crowding_metric,
         ROUND((l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd) / s.candidate_period_days) AS epoch_n,
         l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd - ROUND((l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd) / s.candidate_period_days) * s.candidate_period_days AS dt_days,
         l.btjd - (s.candidate_t0_btjd + 0.5 * s.candidate_period_days) - ROUND((l.btjd - (s.candidate_t0_btjd + 0.5 * s.candidate_period_days)) / s.candidate_period_days) * s.candidate_period_days AS dt_sec_days
  FROM lightcurves l
  JOIN stellar_catalog s ON l.tic_id = s.tic_id
  WHERE l.quality_flag = 0
),
stats AS (
  SELECT tic_id, MAX(P) AS P, MAX(dur_hr) AS dur_hr, MAX(stellar_density_gcc) AS host_rho, MAX(crowding_metric) AS crowd,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN epoch_n END) AS n_transits,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN 1 END) AS n_in,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) > 1.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(dt_sec_days) > 1.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS out_mean,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS in_mean,
         STDDEV_SAMP(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) > 1.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(dt_sec_days) > 1.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS out_sd,
         SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN flux_err_ppm * flux_err_ppm END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN 1 END), 0) AS in_err
  FROM lc_clean
  GROUP BY tic_id
)
SELECT tic_id, P, dur_hr, host_rho, crowd, n_transits, n_in,
       (out_mean - in_mean) AS depth_ppm,
       (out_mean - in_mean) / NULLIF(in_err, 0) AS snr_err,
       (out_mean - in_mean) / NULLIF(out_sd / SQRT(n_in), 0) AS snr_sd
FROM stats
WHERE (out_mean - in_mean) >= 100
ORDER BY snr_err DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH lc AS (
  SELECT l.tic_id, l.btjd, l.rel_flux_ppm, l.flux_err_ppm,
         s.candidate_period_days AS P, s.candidate_t0_btjd AS t0, s.candidate_duration_hours AS dur_hr,
         s.stellar_density_gcc AS host_rho, s.crowding_metric AS crowd,
         CAST(ROUND((l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd) / s.candidate_period_days) AS INTEGER) AS epoch_n,
         l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd - ROUND((l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd) / s.candidate_period_days) * s.candidate_period_days AS dt_days,
         l.btjd - (s.candidate_t0_btjd + 0.5 * s.candidate_period_days) - ROUND((l.btjd - (s.candidate_t0_btjd + 0.5 * s.candidate_period_days)) / s.candidate_period_days) * s.candidate_period_days AS dt_sec_days
  FROM lightcurves l
  JOIN stellar_catalog s ON l.tic_id = s.tic_id
  WHERE l.quality_flag = 0
    AND l.tic_id IN ('TIC-204376737', 'TIC-167814656', 'TIC-325178532', 'TIC-235037790', 'TIC-300710088', 'TIC-266968250')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT tic_id, MAX(P) AS P, MAX(dur_hr) AS dur_hr, MAX(host_rho) AS host_rho, MAX(crowd) AS crowd,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) > 1.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(dt_sec_days) > 1.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS out_mean,
         STDDEV_SAMP(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) > 1.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(dt_sec_days) > 1.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS out_sd,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS in_mean,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN 1 END) AS n_in,
         SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN flux_err_ppm * flux_err_ppm END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN 1 END), 0) AS in_err,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(epoch_n % 2) = 1 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS odd_mean,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(epoch_n % 2) = 1 THEN 1 END) AS n_odd,
         SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(epoch_n % 2) = 1 THEN flux_err_ppm * flux_err_ppm END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(epoch_n % 2) = 1 THEN 1 END), 0) AS odd_err,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(epoch_n % 2) = 0 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS even_mean,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(epoch_n % 2) = 0 THEN 1 END) AS n_even,
         SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(epoch_n % 2) = 0 THEN flux_err_ppm * flux_err_ppm END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 AND ABS(epoch_n % 2) = 0 THEN 1 END), 0) AS even_err,
         AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_sec_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS sec_mean,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_sec_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN 1 END) AS n_sec,
         SQRT(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_sec_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN flux_err_ppm * flux_err_ppm END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_sec_days) <= 0.5 * dur_hr / 24.0 THEN 1 END), 0) AS sec_err
  FROM lc
  GROUP BY tic_id
)
SELECT tic_id,
       (out_mean - in_mean) AS depth_ppm,
       (out_mean - odd_mean) AS odd_depth,
       (out_mean - even_mean) AS even_depth,
       ABS(odd_mean - even_mean) / SQRT(odd_err*odd_err + even_err*even_err) AS odd_even_sigma_err,
       ABS(odd_mean - even_mean) / (out_sd * SQRT(1.0/n_odd + 1.0/n_even)) AS odd_even_sigma_sd,
       (out_mean - sec_mean) AS sec_depth_ppm,
       (out_mean - sec_mean) / sec_err AS sec_snr_err,
       (out_mean - sec_mean) / (out_sd / SQRT(n_sec)) AS sec_snr_sd,
       host_rho,
       1.8954 * P / POWER(dur_hr, 3) AS rho_transit_approx,
       (1.8954 * P / POWER(dur_hr, 3)) / host_rho AS rho_ratio_approx,
       crowd
FROM agg
ORDER BY depth_ppm DESC
LIMIT 20

  WHERE p.tic_id IN ('TIC-204376737', 'TIC-167814656', 'TIC-325178532', 'TIC-235037790', 'TIC-300710088')
)

       MAX(diff_snr) AS peak_diff_snr,
       MAX(target_row) AS target_row,
       MAX(target_col) AS target_col,
       SUM(CASE WHEN diff_snr > 0 THEN row_idx * diff_snr * diff_snr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN diff_snr > 0 THEN diff_snr * diff_snr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cent_row_pos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN diff_snr > 0 THEN col_idx * diff_snr * diff_snr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN diff_snr > 0 THEN diff_snr * diff_snr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cent_col_pos,
       SQRT(
         POWER(SUM(CASE WHEN diff_snr > 0 THEN row_idx * diff_snr * diff_snr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN diff_snr > 0 THEN diff_snr * diff_snr ELSE 0 END), 0) - MAX(target_row), 2) +
         POWER(SUM(CASE WHEN diff_snr > 0 THEN col_idx * diff_snr * diff_snr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN diff_snr > 0 THEN diff_snr * diff_snr ELSE 0 END), 0) - MAX(target_col), 2)
       ) AS offset_pos,
       SQRT(
         POWER(SUM(row_idx * diff_snr * diff_snr) / NULLIF(SUM(diff_snr * diff_snr), 0) - MAX(target_row), 2) +
         POWER(SUM(col_idx * diff_snr * diff_snr) / NULLIF(SUM(diff_snr * diff_snr), 0) - MAX(target_col), 2)
       ) AS offset_all,
       MAX(crowding_metric) AS crowd
FROM ps
GROUP BY tic_id
ORDER BY peak_diff_snr DESC
LIMIT 20

bins AS (

SELECT s.candidate_period_days AS P,
       s.candidate_duration_hours AS T14_hr,
       s.stellar_density_gcc AS host_rho,
       0.024315 * s.candidate_period_days * POWER(1.0 + SQRT(0.0242), 3) / POWER(s.candidate_duration_hours / 24.0, 3) AS rho_seager_rp,

baseline.rationale: Across the sector catalog (117 candidate stars), only TIC-229750058 passes checks (1) periodic_transit_snr (2 transits, depth ~8418 ppm >= 150 ppm, SNR ~37.9 >= 7.0), (2) odd_even_eclipse_clean (odd/even difference 0.17 sigma < 3.0, secondary occultation SNR -1.33 < 4.5), and (3) keplerian_density_match (rho_transit / stellar_density_gcc = 2.96 in [0.18, 5.5]), while TIC-167814656 passes periodic_transit_snr (depth 165.2 ppm, SNR 12.1) and keplerian_density_match (ratio 1.94) but fails odd_even_eclipse_clean (odd/even diff 3.5 sigma >= 3.0) and lacks a pixel stamp. Crucially, for TIC-229750058 (the sole entry in pixel_stamps), check (4) ccd_centroid_lock fails because its peak pixel diff_snr is only 4.1978, strictly below the required >= 5.5 threshold (despite centroid offset 0.266 <= 0.45 px and crowding_metric 0.888 >= 0.80). Because no single TIC star passes all four required physical vetting checks, confirmed_planet_tic is 'none_verified', recommended_followup is 'request_spectroscopy' (since periodic transits were detected), and sufficiently_verified is 'no'.
queries_executed: SELECT * FROM stellar_catalog ORDER BY tic_id LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_stars, COUNT(DISTINCT sector) AS n_sectors FROM stellar_catalog LIMIT 5

WITH lc AS (
  SELECT
    l.tic_id,
    s.sector,
    s.candidate_period_days AS P,
    s.candidate_t0_btjd AS t0,
    s.candidate_duration_hours / 24.0 AS dur_d,
    s.stellar_density_gcc,
    s.crowding_metric,
    l.btjd,
    l.rel_flux_ppm,
    l.flux_err_ppm,
    ROUND((l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd) / s.candidate_period_days) AS epoch_num,
    l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd - ROUND((l.btjd - s.candidate_t0_btjd) / s.candidate_period_days) * s.candidate_period_days AS dt_pri,
    l.btjd - (s.candidate_t0_btjd + 0.5 * s.candidate_period_days) - ROUND((l.btjd - (s.candidate_t0_btjd + 0.5 * s.candidate_period_days)) / s.candidate_period_days) * s.candidate_period_days AS dt_sec
  FROM lightcurves l
  JOIN stellar_catalog s ON l.tic_id = s.tic_id
  WHERE l.quality_flag = 0
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    tic_id,
    sector,
    MAX(P) AS P,
    MAX(dur_d) * 24.0 AS dur_h,
    MAX(stellar_density_gcc) AS host_rho,
    MAX(crowding_metric) AS crowding,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) <= 0.5 * dur_d THEN epoch_num END) AS n_transits,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) <= 0.5 * dur_d THEN 1 END) AS n_in,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) > 0.75 * dur_d AND ABS(dt_sec) > 0.75 * dur_d THEN 1 END) AS n_out,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) <= 0.5 * dur_d THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS in_depth_ppm,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) > 0.75 * dur_d AND ABS(dt_sec) > 0.75 * dur_d THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS out_base_ppm,
    STDDEV_SAMP(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) > 0.75 * dur_d AND ABS(dt_sec) > 0.75 * dur_d THEN rel_flux_ppm END) AS out_std_ppm,
    AVG(flux_err_ppm) AS mean_err_ppm,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) <= 0.5 * dur_d AND CAST(ABS(epoch_num) AS INTEGER) % 2 = 1 THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS odd_depth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) <= 0.5 * dur_d AND CAST(ABS(epoch_num) AS INTEGER) % 2 = 1 THEN 1 END) AS n_odd,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) <= 0.5 * dur_d AND CAST(ABS(epoch_num) AS INTEGER) % 2 = 0 THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS even_depth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_pri) <= 0.5 * dur_d AND CAST(ABS(epoch_num) AS INTEGER) % 2 = 0 THEN 1 END) AS n_even,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_sec) <= 0.5 * dur_d THEN -rel_flux_ppm END) AS sec_depth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(dt_sec) <= 0.5 * dur_d THEN 1 END) AS n_sec
  FROM lc
  GROUP BY tic_id, sector
)
SELECT
  tic_id,
  sector,
  n_transits,
  ROUND(in_depth_ppm - out_base_ppm, 1) AS depth_ppm,
  ROUND((in_depth_ppm - out_base_ppm) / (out_std_ppm / SQRT(n_in)), 2) AS snr_std,
  ROUND((in_depth_ppm - out_base_ppm) / (mean_err_ppm / SQRT(n_in)), 2) AS snr_err,
  ROUND(ABS(odd_depth - even_depth) / (out_std_ppm * SQRT(1.0/NULLIF(n_odd,0) + 1.0/NULLIF(n_even,0))), 2) AS oe_sigma,
  ROUND((sec_depth - out_base_ppm) / (out_std_ppm / SQRT(NULLIF(n_sec,0))), 2) AS sec_snr,
  ROUND(host_rho, 4) AS host_rho,
  ROUND(crowding, 4) AS crowding
FROM stats
WHERE (in_depth_ppm - out_base_ppm) >= 120
ORDER BY snr_std DESC
LIMIT 30

WITH ps AS (
  SELECT
    p.tic_id,
    p.sector,
    MAX(p.diff_snr) AS peak_diff_snr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.diff_snr > 0 THEN p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr * p.row_idx ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.diff_snr > 0 THEN p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS c_row_pos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.diff_snr > 0 THEN p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr * p.col_idx ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.diff_snr > 0 THEN p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS c_col_pos,
    SUM(p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr * p.row_idx) / NULLIF(SUM(p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr), 0) AS c_row_all,
    SUM(p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr * p.col_idx) / NULLIF(SUM(p.diff_snr * p.diff_snr), 0) AS c_col_all,
    MAX(p.target_row) AS target_row,
    MAX(p.target_col) AS target_col
  FROM pixel_stamps p
  GROUP BY p.tic_id, p.sector
)
SELECT
  ps.tic_id,
  ps.sector,
  ROUND(ps.peak_diff_snr, 3) AS peak_diff_snr,
  ROUND(SQRT(POWER(ps.c_row_pos - ps.target_row, 2) + POWER(ps.c_col_pos - ps.target_col, 2)), 4) AS offset_pos,
  ROUND(SQRT(POWER(ps.c_row_all - ps.target_row, 2) + POWER(ps.c_col_all - ps.target_col, 2)), 4) AS offset_all,
  ROUND(s.crowding_metric, 4) AS crowding_metric,
  ROUND(s.candidate_period_days, 6) AS P_days,
  ROUND(s.candidate_duration_hours, 4) AS dur_hrs,
  ROUND(s.stellar_density_gcc, 5) AS host_rho_gcc
FROM ps
JOIN stellar_catalog s ON ps.tic_id = s.tic_id
WHERE ps.peak_diff_snr >= 4.0 OR ps.tic_id IN ('TIC-229750058', 'TIC-167814656', 'TIC-325178532')
ORDER BY ps.peak_diff_snr DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT
  tic_id,
  sector,
  COUNT(*) AS n_pix,
  ROUND(MAX(diff_snr), 4) AS max_diff_snr,
  ROUND(MIN(diff_snr), 4) AS min_diff_snr,
  ROUND(MAX(target_row), 4) AS target_row,
  ROUND(MAX(target_col), 4) AS target_col
FROM pixel_stamps
GROUP BY tic_id, sector
ORDER BY max_diff_snr DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT row_idx, col_idx, ROUND(mean_out_flux, 2) AS out_f, ROUND(mean_in_flux, 2) AS in_f, ROUND(diff_flux, 3) AS diff_f, ROUND(diff_snr, 4) AS diff_snr, aperture_mask, ROUND(target_row, 4) AS trow, ROUND(target_col, 4) AS tcol FROM pixel_stamps WHERE tic_id = 'TIC-229750058' ORDER BY diff_snr DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT
  tic_id,
  sector,
  candidate_period_days AS P_d,
  candidate_duration_hours AS T_h,
  stellar_density_gcc AS host_rho,
  ROUND((3.0 * PI() / (6.6743e-8 * POWER(candidate_period_days * 86400.0, 2))) * POWER((candidate_period_days * 24.0) / (PI() * candidate_duration_hours), 3), 5) AS rho_transit_circ,
  ROUND(((3.0 * PI() / (6.6743e-8 * POWER(candidate_period_days * 86400.0, 2))) * POWER((candidate_period_days * 24.0) / (PI() * candidate_duration_hours), 3)) / stellar_density_gcc, 4) AS rho_ratio
FROM stellar_catalog
WHERE tic_id IN ('TIC-229750058', 'TIC-167814656', 'TIC-325178532')
ORDER BY tic_id
LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tic_id) AS n_ps_tics, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM pixel_stamps LIMIT 5
